descriptionText:
This Dodgers Matt Kemp #27 Action Figure Figurine Statue is the perfect addition to any baseball fan's collection. It features the Los Angeles Dodgers player in his 2014 SGA uniform and is officially licensed by Major League Baseball. The multi-color figure is made in China and is a stadium giveaway.

The product is an action figure and is featured in the Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop category under Fan Apparel & Souvenirs. It is perfect for fans of the Los Angeles Dodgers team and collectors of baseball memorabilia. This figure is a great way to commemorate the regular season and is sure to be a prized possession for years to come.
